phase: Phase 8: Adversarial and Dynamic Scenario Testing

Scenario A: Model Poisoning.A2_perturbation: Delta_attack = Delta_honest + epsilon * u, tested at epsilon = 2.0

Scenario B: Free-Riding.B3_stale_replay: Replay of previous round update with historical metadata (age >= 1)

Scenario D: Honest Non-IID Control.heterogeneity: 10 distinct task_load, mobility, and link_reliability client conditions

invariant_verification.task_partition_identity: Verified on all 225 rows: completion_rate + failure_rate + miss_rate == 1.0
invariant_verification.ground_truth_isolation: Verified: ClientScenarioLabel kept strictly separated from detector inputs
invariant_verification.checkpoint_fingerprinting: Verified: SHA256 parameter hash computed and recorded for each trial model

free_riding_zero_update.mechanism: m4 originality flag reliably detects zero-norm updates

free_riding_copy_update.mechanism: m4 detects 100% of copied updates; precision impacted by symmetrical pair detection

free_riding_stale_replay.mechanism: m3 staleness detects replay in round >= 1; round 0 has age = 0

model_poisoning_sign_flip.mechanism: Non-IID client gradient diversity widens consensus cone, making directional detection challenging at low rounds

honest_non_iid_fpr.significance: Honest non-IID clients with high mobility or heavy load are not unfairly penalized as malicious (FPR <= 3.3%)
